statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-86597 (GHSA-qqj6-54q6-cxv6, GO-2026-6665): the Snowflake Go driver can write authentication tokens, query-result encryption keys, pre-signed URLs and SAML assertions to its logs. Every github.com/snowflakedb/gosnowflake (v1) release up to 1.19.1 is affected and no fixed v1 release exists; github.com/snowflakedb/gosnowflake/v2 is fixed in 2.2.0 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qqj6-54q6-cxv6, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6665, https://docs.snowflake.com/en/release-notes/clients-drivers/golang-2026#version-220-sep-03-2026; release https://github.com/snowflakedb/gosnowflake/pull/1844). Read the Go build information (go version -m) and function symbols (go tool nm) of /usr/bin/alloy in full in these published alloy-dev packages for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository, each checked against the index SHA256: 1.18.1-0 (arm64), 1.19.2-6 (amd64 and arm64), 1.19.2-7 (amd64 and arm64), 1.20.1-0 (arm64), 1.20.1-1 (amd64 and arm64), 1.20.1-2 (amd64 and arm64), 1.20.1-3 (amd64 and arm64), 1.21.0-0 (amd64 and arm64), 1.22.0-16 (arm64). The other published alloy-dev builds (44 builds from 1.18.1-0 to the current 1.22.0-16; 1.21.2-0 is published for arm64 only) were not read in full. In every package read, the driver's code is linked (go tool nm lists its functions) and the build information has no replace directive for either module, and no build carries both. The driver module read by build is 1.18.1-0: gosnowflake (v1) v1.19.1; 1.19.2-6: gosnowflake (v1) v1.19.1; 1.19.2-7: gosnowflake (v1) v1.19.1; 1.20.1-0: gosnowflake (v1) v1.19.1; 1.20.1-1: gosnowflake (v1) v1.19.1; 1.20.1-2: gosnowflake (v1) v1.19.1; 1.20.1-3: gosnowflake (v1) v1.19.1; 1.21.0-0: gosnowflake/v2 v2.2.0; 1.22.0-16: gosnowflake/v2 v2.2.0. Builds not read fall on the same side as the builds read around them: the upstream alloy go.mod requires gosnowflake v1.19.1 for 1.18.1 to 1.20.1 and gosnowflake/v2 v2.2.0 from 1.21.0 (https://github.com/grafana/alloy/blob/v1.20.1/collector/go.mod, https://github.com/grafana/alloy/blob/v1.21.0/collector/go.mod). The range ends at 1.21.0-0, the first build that carries gosnowflake/v2 v2.2.0 instead of v1.
